therapeutic.definition: helping to heal, improve health, or reduce pain

throw.definition: to send an object through the air using the arm and hand.

throw-in.definition: a way of putting the ball back into play from the sideline after it goes out of court

throwing arc.definition: the curved line or area that helps mark where a throw must be made from

throwing area.definition: the marked place where a throwing event happens

throwing cage.definition: a protective fenced area used to help control the direction of throws

throwing circle.definition: the round area where an athlete stands to perform a throw.

throwing events.definition: field events in which athletes throw an object as far as possible

thumb.definition: the short thick finger on the side of the hand

tides.definition: the regular rising and falling of the sea level

torso.definition: the main part of the body, not including the head, arms, or legs.

track events.definition: athletics events that take place on a running track

trajectory.definition: the curved path an object follows through the air.

trampoline.definition: a strong stretched surface used for bouncing and performing jumps

treading water.definition: the skill of staying upright in deep water without sinking

trial.definition: one official chance for an athlete to perform a jump.

triple jump.definition: a field event where an athlete performs a hop, a step, and a jump to travel as far as possible.

tuck.definition: a body position where the knees are pulled in close to the chest

tucked pullover.definition: a bar skill where the gymnast pulls the knees up in a tuck and rolls the body over the bar into front support

tumbling.definition: a series of rolling, flipping, or jumping movements done on the floor.

turn.definition: A movement where a gymnast rotates the body while staying balanced.

turnover.definition: a moment when one team loses the ball and the other team gains it

umpire.definition: an official who makes sure the rules are followed in a game

underhand grip.definition: a way of holding a bar with the palms facing toward the body

undulating.definition: moving in a smooth wave-like way

uneven bars.definition: Uneven bars are a gymnastics apparatus with two horizontal bars set at different heights.

uniform.definition: special clothes worn by members of the same team, school, or group

unsporting behaviour.definition: rude or unfair behaviour that goes against the spirit of the game

upright.definition: standing straight up in a vertical position

V-grip.definition: a way of holding the javelin between the index and middle fingers in a V shape

V-sit.definition: A position where the body forms a V shape, usually supported by the hands with the legs lifted.

valid attempt.definition: a jump that follows the rules and is allowed to be measured.

vault.definition: A vault is a gymnastics event where the gymnast pushes off a vaulting table and lands after a jump, flip, or twist.

vault table.definition: the padded apparatus a gymnast pushes off during a vault.

vaulting table.definition: A vaulting table is the padded apparatus a gymnast pushes off during a vault.

vertical.definition: moving or pointing up and down.

vertical jump.definition: a jump in which the athlete tries to go as high as possible.

warm up.definition: simple exercises done before activity to prepare the body

warm-up.definition: light exercise done before playing or training to prepare the body

western roll.definition: an older high jump technique where the athlete rolls the body sideways over the bar

whistle.definition: a small tool that makes a sharp sound to signal the start or stop of play

wind gauge.definition: a tool used to measure the speed of the wind.

wind indicator.definition: a tool that shows the direction or strength of the wind

wing attack.definition: the player who passes the ball into the shooting area and creates space in attack

wing defense.definition: the player who marks the wing attack and tries to stop passes into the shooting area

wrist.definition: The joint that connects the hand to the arm.

wrist guard.definition: protective support worn on the wrist to help prevent injury

wrist rotation.definition: the turning movement of the wrist
